stem:
Meera's family in a village in Rajasthan uses sunlight in many ways. On one day, thick clouds cover the sky all day and no direct sunlight reaches their home.

Which of these activities will be most affected that day?

options.text: Drying washed clothes on a line outside
Grinding wheat flour using an electric flour mill
Cooking dal on a gas stove in the kitchen
Drawing water from a well using a hand pump

teacher.key_rationale: Drying clothes outdoors depends directly on the Sun's heat; without sunlight the clothes dry very slowly. Grinding, cooking on gas, and drawing water by hand pump do not depend on sunlight, so option A is the only sunlight-dependent activity.
